name: 84119 · W Valley City, UT
findings: ZIP 84119 (W Valley City) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84119 (W Valley City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
